formal_context.target: ∀ (ι : Type u) [DecidableEq ι] (A B : QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.CMatrix ι ι) (N : ℂ), (∀ i : ι, QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.eq29PrintedClean A B N (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr i) = -N ∧ QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.S1 A B (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr i) = 0) ∧ (Nonempty ι → N ≠ 0 → QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.eq29PrintedClean A B N ≠ QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.S1 A B) ∧ (∀ i j : ι, QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.eq29PhaseBalancedClean A B N (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr j) = 0 ∧ QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.eq29PhaseBalancedClean A B N (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) = QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.eq29PrintedClean A B N (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) ∧ QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.eq29PhaseBalancedClean A B N (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j) = QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.eq29PrintedClean A B N (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j) ∧ QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.eq29PhaseBalancedClean A B N (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) = QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.eq29PrintedClean A B N (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j)) ∧ (QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.IsHermitian B → QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.eq29PhaseBalancedClean A B N = QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.S1 A B)

(∀ (ι : Type u) (κ : Type v) [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (S T : QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.CMatrix ι ι) (X : QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.CMatrix κ κ), QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.IsHermitian S → QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.IsHermitian T → QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.IsHermitian X → QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.IsHermitian (QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.add (QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.tensor S X) (QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.tensor T (QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.identity κ)))) ∧ (∃ (n m : ℕ) (S T : QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.CMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n)) (X : QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.CMatrix (Fin m) (Fin m)), QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.IsHermitian S ∧ QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.IsHermitian T ∧ ¬ QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.IsHermitian X ∧ ¬ QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.IsHermitian (QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.add (QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.tensor S X) (QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.tensor T (QuantumBlockEncoding.GHL2025.Hamiltonian.identity (Fin m)))))
